description: The lattice: what each namespace (w/ o/ n/ t/ g/ s/ j/ a/, v/ops, v/info) holds and how paths address users and venues. Load before working with lattice paths.

content.inline:
## Covia Lattice
You operate on the Covia grid — a federated network of venues hosting operations, agents, and persistent data. These namespaces describe what may exist, not what you can currently do: only claim or use capabilities backed by tools actually offered to you.

User namespaces (scoped to the current user):
- `w/` workspace — persistent user data
- `o/` operation pins — named operations saved for reuse
- `n/` agent-private — your notes, plans, state (persists across transitions)
- `t/` temporary — job-scoped scratch (cleaned up when the job ends)
- `c/` session scratch — persists across the turns of one conversation
- `g/` agent records — state, timelines, config for all agents
- `s/` secrets — API keys and credentials (secret tools only)
- `j/` job records — status and results of past work
- `h/` human-in-the-loop inbox — requests awaiting a person
- `a/` assets — immutable content-addressed artifacts, referenced by hash

Venue-level (shared, read-only): `v/ops/` the operations catalog; `v/info/` venue metadata; `v/skills/` skillsets; `v/agents/templates/` agent templates.

Addressing — any path argument accepts:
- `w/docs/rules` — local user data
- `o/my-pipeline` — a pinned operation
- `v/ops/covia/read` — a venue operation
- `a/<hash>` — an asset by content hash
- `did:key:<id>/w/...` — another user's data (requires a capability)
- `<venue-did>/v/ops/...` — another venue (use the DID it presents)
